newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hanny in rights issue, Hutchison ups stake.
newsitem.headline: Hanny in rights issue, Hutchison ups stake.

text.p: Hanny Holdings Ltd said on Friday it plans to raise about HK$257.8 million through a four-for-five rights issue and that it agreed with two Hutchison Whampoa Ltd units to make an early repayment of a convertible redeemable note isued by Hanny in late 1995.

Hutchison's Hoodscoot Ltd agreed to procure Hutchison's Cobbleford Ltd to subscribe to 88 million new Hanny shares at HK$1.30 and the proceeds of HK$114.40 million would be used to repay part of the US$27.98 principal of the note to Hoodscoot.
After the rights issue and early repayment, Huchison's stake in Hanny would rise to 34.18 percent from 19.81, it said.

The rights shares to be issued at HK$0.80 per share would raise a total of HK$250 million after expenses and part of the proceeds would be used to repay the balance of the convertible redeemable note, the company said.
The remaining balance of about HK$196.42 million would serve as working capital of the group and to fund its new investments.

Hanny said after the rights issue and the early repayment interested parties including Hutchison, Cheung Kong group, International Tak Cheung Holdings group and Burcon group would hold a total of 55.54 percent of the company compared with 45.85 percent currently.
